Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
with Restricted in play can a vampire attempt to hunt off of a vampire
with no blood, even if there are other legal targets with blood on
them?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Robert Scythe wrote:
> with Restricted [Vitae] in play can a vampire attempt to hunt off of a vampire

> with no blood, even if there are other legal targets with blood on
> them?

Sure. Key word: "other legal". The empty younger vampire is indeed a legal target.
